You press an open hand toward the injury and give a measured surge of your own warmth, keeping your voice steady as the effort leaves you pale.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One willing creature within 3 squares, including self.
Duration
Healing and reductions are immediate.
Equipment / acquisition
A free hand; no item granted.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Pay 3 HP before rolling, bypassing all resistance and leaving yourself above 0. A free hand is required. Apply Life resistance to healing, minimum 1 while HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP.

Weak
Restore 5 HP.
Standard
Restore 10 HP and reduce temporary Bleeding by 1.
Strong
Restore 15 HP, reduce temporary Bleeding by 2 and temporary Dazed by 1.

This removes no wound or scar and does not restore Grit or reverse Last Words. It is a complete healing spell, not a modifier requiring another learned heal.

A willing creature explicitly harmed by healing instead takes the listed HP amount as Life damage, with normal resistance and minimum damage; apply no beneficial recovery riders. An unwilling creature harmed by healing can be targeted as described below.

Additional rulings

Tags: Magic / Recovery

Offensive healing — latest agreement: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.
